arabic text: MAUT KI AAGHOSH ME JAB THAK KE SO JAATI HAI MAA\nTAB KAHIN JAA KAR RAZA THODA SUKOON PAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: WHEN, WEARY, A MOTHER FALLS ASLEEP IN DEATH'S EMBRACE,\nONLY THEN, O RAZA, DOES SHE FIND A LITTLE PEACE.

arabic text: FIKR ME BACHON KI KUCH IS TARAH GHUL JAATI HAI MAA\nNAUJAWAAN HOTE HUWE BOODHI NAZAR AATI HAI MAA
english translation text: A MOTHER SO MELTS AWAY IN WORRY FOR HER CHILDREN\nTHAT WHILE STILL YOUNG, SHE LOOKS OLD.

arabic text: RO DIYA JO FATIMA ZAHRA KI MAIYYAT PAR HUSSAIN\nTOD KAR BAND-E-KAFAN SEENE SE LIPTAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: WHEN HUSSAIN (AS) WEPT OVER THE BODY OF BIBI FATEMA ZAHRA (AS),\nBREAKING THE TIES OF HER SHROUD, THE MOTHER CLASPS HIM TO HER CHEST.

arabic text: AAG LE KAR DAR PE TERE AA GAYE JAB UMMATI\nHAAYE DAR-O-DEEWAR KE MA-BAIN PIS JAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: WHEN THE PEOPLE OF THE UMMAH CAME TO YOUR DOOR WITH FIRE,\nALAS, A MOTHER IS CRUSHED BETWEEN THE DOOR AND THE WALL.

arabic text: CHAAHE HUM KHUSHIYON ME MAA KO BHOOL JAAYEN DOSTO\nJAB MUSEEBAT SAR PE PADTI HAI TO YAAD AATI HAI MAA
english translation text: O FRIENDS, WE MAY FORGET OUR MOTHER IN OUR DAYS OF JOY,\nBUT WHEN HARDSHIP FALLS UPON US, WE REMEMBER OUR MOTHER.

arabic text: YAAD AATA HAI SHAB-E-AASHOOR KA KADIYAL JAWAAN\nJAB KABHI ULJHI HUWI ZULFON KO SULJHAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: THE TALL YOUTH OF THE EVE OF ASHURA, ALI AKBAR (AS), COMES TO MIND\nWHENEVER A MOTHER UNTANGLES TANGLED LOCKS OF HAIR.

arabic text: JAB TALAK YE HAATH HAIN HAMSHEER BE-PARDA NA HO\nEK BAHAADUR BAWAFA GHAZI SE FARMAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: "AS LONG AS THESE HANDS REMAIN, LET YOUR SISTER NOT BE LEFT UNVEILED,"\nA MOTHER INSTRUCTS HER BRAVE AND LOYAL GHAZI ABBAS (AS).

arabic text: PYAAR KEHTE HAIN KISE AUR MAMTA KYA CHEEZ HAI\nKOI UN BACHON SE POOCHE JIN KI MAR JAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: WHAT IS LOVE, AND WHAT IS A MOTHER'S LOVE?\nASK THOSE CHILDREN WHOSE MOTHER HAS DIED.

arabic text: SHUKRIYA HO HI NAHIN SAKTA KABHI MAA KA ADA\nMARTE MARTE BHI DUA JEENE KI DE JAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: THE THANKS WE OWE A MOTHER CAN NEVER BE REPAID;\nEVEN AS SHE DIES, SHE LEAVES US A PRAYER FOR OUR LIFE.

arabic text: APNE GHAM KO BHOOL KAR ROTE HAIN JO SHABBIR KO\nUNKE ASHKON KE LIYE JANNAT SE AA JAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: FOR THOSE WHO FORGET THEIR OWN GRIEF AND WEEP FOR SHABBIR (AS),\nA MOTHER COMES DOWN FROM PARADISE FOR THEIR TEARS.

arabic text: UMR BHAR GHAAFIL NA HONA MATAM-E-SHABBIR SE\nRAAT DIN APNE AMAL SE HUM KO SAMJHAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: "NEVER, ALL YOUR LIFE, BE HEEDLESS OF THE MATAM FOR SHABBIR (AS),"\nNIGHT AND DAY, BY HER OWN EXAMPLE, A MOTHER TEACHES US.

arabic text: MARTABA MAA KA HO ZAAHIR IS LIYE FIRDAUS SE\nAPNE BACHCHON KE LIYE POSHAAK MANGWAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: SO THAT A MOTHER'S RANK MAY BE MADE KNOWN,\nA MOTHER HAS CLOTHES SENT FROM PARADISE FOR HER CHILDREN.

arabic text: SAB SE PEHLE JAAN DENA FATIMA KE LAAL PAR\nRAAT BHAR AUN-O-MUHAMMAD KO YE SAMJHAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: "BE THE FIRST TO GIVE YOUR LIVES FOR THE SON OF BIBI FATEMA (AS),"\nALL NIGHT LONG, A MOTHER TELLS AUN AND MUHAMMAD.

arabic text: NAUJAWAAN BETA AGAR DAM TOD DE AAGHOSH ME\nZINDAGI BHAR SAR KO DEEWARON SE TAKRAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: IF A YOUNG SON BREATHES HIS LAST IN HER EMBRACE,\nA MOTHER BEATS HER HEAD AGAINST THE WALLS FOR THE REST OF HER LIFE.

arabic text: FATIMA KE LAAL PAR QURBAAN KARNE KE LIYE\nBAANDH KAR SEHRA JAWAAN BETE KO LAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: TO SACRIFICE HIM FOR THE SON OF BIBI FATEMA (AS),\nA MOTHER TIES THE WEDDING GARLAND ON HER YOUNG SON AND BRINGS HIM.

arabic text: KHOON ME DOOBE HUWE AATE HAIN JAB SEHRE KE PHOOL\nEK EK TUKDE KO APNE DIL SE LIPTAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: WHEN THE FLOWERS OF THE WEDDING GARLAND COME BACK DROWNED IN BLOOD,\nA MOTHER CLASPS EVERY SINGLE PIECE TO HER HEART.

arabic text: LAASH-E-QASIM PAR KAHA ZINDA RAHI TO AAUNGI\nAB TO SOO-E-SHAAM DULHAN KO LIYE JAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: OVER THE BODY OF QASIM (AS) SHE SAID, "IF I LIVE, I WILL RETURN,"\nNOW A MOTHER TAKES THE BRIDE AWAY TOWARDS SHAAM.

arabic text: LAASH PAR BETE KI PADHTI HAI JAWAANI MARSIYA\nSHUKR KA SAJDA IS AALAM ME BAJA LAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: OVER HER SON'S BODY, SHE RECITES AN ELEGY FOR HIS YOUTH,\nAND EVEN IN THAT STATE, A MOTHER BOWS IN A PROSTRATION OF THANKS.

arabic text: ALLAH ALLAH INTEHAA-E-SABR-E-LAILA-O-HUSSAIN\nBAAP NE KHEENCHI SINAAN SEENE KO SEHLAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: ALLAH, ALLAH! THE UTMOST PATIENCE OF BIBI LAILA (SA) AND HUSSAIN (AS):\nTHE FATHER PULLED OUT THE SPEARHEAD, THE MOTHER STROKES THE CHEST.

arabic text: YE BATA SAKTI HAI HUM KO BAS RABAB-E-KHASTA-TAN\nKIS TARAH BIN DOODH KE BACHCHE KO BEHLAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: ONLY THE GRIEF-WORN BIBI RABAB (SA) CAN TELL US\nHOW A MOTHER SOOTHES HER BABY WITHOUT MILK.

arabic text: SHIMR KE KHANJAR SE YA SOOKHE GALE SE POOCHHIYE\nMAA IDHAR SE NIKALTA HAI UDHAR AATI HAI MAA
english translation text: ASK SHIMR'S DAGGER, OR ASK THE PARCHED THROAT:\nTHE CRY "MOTHER!" LEAVES FROM HERE, AND FROM THERE THE MOTHER COMES.

arabic text: DE KAR APNE LAAL KO ISLAM KI AAGHOSH ME\nGODH KHAALI PHIR SOO-E-JANNAT PALAT JAATI HAI MAA
english translation text: GIVING HER BELOVED SON INTO THE EMBRACE OF ISLAM,\nA MOTHER TURNS BACK TOWARDS PARADISE WITH AN EMPTY LAP.
